Trunks of a clone set

Source: R/clones_assign.R
clone_trunks.Rd

Groups clones that share their clonal events: complete-linkage clustering of clone_state_distance() cut at max_dist bp (two clones of one trunk differ allelically on less than max_dist of the genome). Trunks are the units of block orientation for within-trunk clone discovery (subclonal events of 5-25 % of a trunk are oriented far better by the trunk's pseudobulk than by all cells) and of the doublet hypotheses (mixtures of clones within a trunk are not scored).

Usage

clone_trunks(segments, max_dist = 5e+07, ...)

Arguments

segments

segments table

max_dist

cut height (bp)

...

passed to clone_state_distance()

Value

named character vector clone -> trunk id (T1, T2, ...)
